basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Embeds governed quantities in existing company records instead of creating a second quantity master.
Distinguishes quantity kinds with equal dimensions, such as energy and torque.
Applies unit offsets only to points, never to differences, and keeps exact affine conversions.

may: Validate a quantity binding against its admitted unit definition.
Convert between units with an exact admitted conversion.
Compare two quantities after checking context and role equality.
mustNot: Insert zero for a missing quantity.
Infer uncertainty from the number of digits.
Invent a linear approximation for an unsupported transform.
Treat a measured value as authorization for billing or conformity.
requiresHuman: Admitting a new unit or conversion definition.
Accepting a normalized value from an incompatible source.

considerations: Wrong units cause physical harm in medicine, engineering and logistics; refusing is safer than guessing.
Quantities used for billing affect what people pay.
affectedParties: People relying on dosages, loads or measurements

owners.steward: The owner of the host record owns its quantity values; unit definitions are owned by the reference data steward.
masterSystems: Unit and quantity-kind reference (for example QUDT, UCUM)

items: Host record ID with its single quantity slot.

properties.reason: A quantity value describes another object; the measured object carries the physical properties.

items: A quantity value has a decimal notation, a unit, a quantity kind and a role (point or difference).
Unit confusion (for example pounds and kilograms).
Product data, logistics, maintenance and any record carrying measurements.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that embeds governed scalar quantities in existing company records, with admitted units and quantity kinds, normalized decimal notation and exact affine unit conversions.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-06: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
